lines.text: Paul gives his own judgment about virgins and tells a man committed to a wife not to seek release.
Those who marry have not sinned but will face persecution, and Paul says the time is short.
The unmarried man is concerned about the work of the Lord, but the married man about pleasing his wife.
He who does not marry the virgin does even better, and a wife is bound while her husband lives.
Paul judges she is happier if she remains as she is, and thinks he too has the approval of Apollos.
